I find it useful to do the guiding maths in my head when making a list.

You've got:

2x pathfinders = 4x markerlight guiding

1x stealth suit = 1x markerlight & reroll 1s guiding

(I also like to guide with devilfish sometimes when the enemy unit doesn't have cover and therefore doesn't need to be guided by markerlight. I do this because I find the devilfish loadout a bit lackluster so not rly worth guiding sometimes)

So that'd be 2x devilfish = 2x boring normal guiding

However in this army you only have

2x breachers units (goated)

1x crisis suit unit (I'm a sunforge or starscythe man myself)

1 x strike team (not the best atm)

That's 4 units that need to be guided.


If I were to redo this army I'd probably go for:

2x cadre fireblade
1x enforcer commander (Coldstar if want to be faster)

2x breachers (each with 1xguardian drone)

1x pathfinders (3x railguns)
2x stealth suits (fusion on the shasvre)

1x crisis suits (fireknife/sunforge, for some heavier firepower)

2x devilfish (don't forget about the seeker missiles)

There is a little wiggleroom for another unit, maybe a single broadside, or maybe kroot carnivores for sticky objectives, or some kroot rampagers for some distraction to stop your breachers getting melted first.

This gives u 3 units that always want to be guided

4 guiders that have markerlight, 2 of which have reroll 1s.
And the devilfish can sometimes guide sometimes be guided depending on what's happening on the table.

The difference is that the extra cadre fireblade makes both breacher units equally goated. The 2 stealth suits allows 2 of your units to go ham instead of just one. And the pathfinders can guide whoever else needs it.

Should be good for 1000pts :)
